ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible; approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels vs 20% low-intensity black pixels across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white high-intensity zone covering the majority of both lobes; dark low-intensity border along trailing edges; dark vertical peduncle with white salt-and-pepper mottling at the insertion point; isolated dark pixel clusters (spots) on the left lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped indentation; interior angle approximately 35 degrees; depth is roughly 10-15% of the fluke's vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency irregular serration pattern; peak-to-valley amplitude is 2-10 pixels; distal tips exhibit extreme jaggedness compared to the medial sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily linear sweep with a slight concave curvature in the outer third of the trailing edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, discrete, low-intensity circular spots (dark on white) primarily on the mid-to-upper portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme jaggedness and potential tissue loss at the terminal tip of the right lobe; distinct dark focal pigmentation marks on the central white field.
